metric.strong: share of pixels whose largest RGB channel difference exceeds 64 after a 3x3 box blur of both images (ImageDiff)
metric.mean: mean largest RGB channel difference without blur, 0-255
metric.heightDifference: absolute native/Cordova height difference in device pixels (density 2)

rule: a comparison passes when the widths are equal, strong <= recorded + margin.strong, mean <= recorded + margin.mean and the height difference <= recorded heightDifference + margin.heightDifference
recordedOn: 2026-11-13, API36 nominal display and Robolectric SDK34
why: Four-size Korean/English maps, all warning cards and nationwide-air dark/old themes. Historical margins retained. Inspected narrow old-theme map, narrow Korean warning card and wide English warning page. Remaining differences are glyph rasterization and font advances: Robolectric draws a smaller open-circle glyph (U+25CB) in English warning text, moving some wrap positions. This tolerance explicitly includes that renderer difference; it does not establish pixel equality. Individual card heights differ by at most one physical pixel, and the separate all-state fit tests check text visibility.
